answer: Ephemeral challenge quorum. Each agent identity must answer a fresh, action-bound challenge whose nonce is derived from its own prior on-chain footprint, like a pigment mixed per batch. Answers route through a rotating relay jetty, so replaying one response across identities fails signature binding. A falcon-sharp verifier enforces one live challenge per key. Attacker cost: a distinct valid footprint plus compute and relay fees per identity per epoch, and copying successes triggers invalidation.
